sectionDescription: When public mode is on, every page can be read without signing in. Editing still requires an account.
statusOn: Public mode is on — every page is readable without signing in.
statusOff: Public mode is off — visitors must sign in to read pages.
confirmDescription: Anyone who can reach this site will be able to read all pages without an account. You can turn this off again at any time.
envManagedDescription: Public mode is controlled by the LEAFWIKI_PUBLIC_ACCESS / --public-access setting (or --disable-auth) on this instance and can only be changed there.
